title: Hush-Cant Novice
text: Hush-Cant Novice sings below hearing and makes nearby receivers tremble in time with the hidden note. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: You feel the hymn first in your teeth.

defeatReward.text: Hush-Cant Novice is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
